description_en: You can invoke RemovePersonalNumbersFromUser to delete one or more personal outbound numbers associated with a specified agent under a specified instance
description_zh: 调用RemovePersonalNumbersFromUser删除指定实例下指定坐席的一个或多个个人外呼号码
kebab_example: aliyun ccc remove-personal-numbers-from-user --instance-id ccc-test --user-id agent@ccc-test --number-list 01012340000_,_01056780000 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemovePersonalNumbersFromUser

parameters.description_en: List of personal outbound numbers to delete. You can obtain the current list of personal outbound numbers associated with the agent by invoking ListPersonalNumbersOfUser.
parameters.description_zh: 待删除的个人外呼号码列表，通过调用ListPersonalNumbersOfUser可获取坐席当前关联的个人外呼号码列表。
parameters.help_en: List of personal outbound numbers to delete. You can obtain the current list of personal outbound numbers associated with the agent by invoking ListPersonalNumbersOfUser
parameters.help_zh: 待删除的个人外呼号码列表，通过调用ListPersonalNumbersOfUser可获取坐席当前关联的个人外呼号码列表
parameters.name: number_list
